prompt: Order the lines that walk a colon-separated `PATH`, trying `dir/name` in each directory in turn and stopping after the last one. One line does not belong.
lines: int n = snprintf(out, out_size, "%.*s/%s", (int)len, p, name);
explain: Find the next colon, measure the directory (to the colon, or to the end for the last entry), skip empty entries and test `dir/name`. When there is no colon left the last entry was just tried, so break; otherwise continue after the colon.
